The sections through Pressure score one soft-bottom habitat. The last section repeats that score for soft bottom of 100 m or less and for soft bottom deeper than 100 m.

```{r}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Target CRS for all vector data (matches OHI regions + fishing rasters)
target_crs <- "EPSG:6372"  # Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC

# Master analysis grid = fishing effort (already EPSG:6372, 1 km)
years <- 2007:2025
fishing_rasters <- rast(
  paste0(
    "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/pressures/vessels/benthic_destructive_fishing/destructive_fishing_hours_",
    years,
    "_1km.tif"
  )
)
nlyr(fishing_rasters)
```

```{r}
# Read OHI regions and transform to Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC before any analysis
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(target_crs)

ohi_land   <- ohi_regions |> dplyr::filter(location == "land")
ohi_marine <- ohi_regions |> dplyr::filter(location == "marine")

```

```{r}
# Read habitat shapefiles and transform to EPSG:6372 before rasterizing
rocky_reef <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/Arrecife rocoso/Arrecife rocoso.shp")) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(target_crs)

seamounts <- st_read(here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/seamount/seamount_merge.shp")) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(target_crs)

```

```{r}
# Clip seamounts to OHI regions (same CRS)
seamounts <- st_intersection(seamounts, ohi_regions)
```

## rocky_reef work:
```{r}
# Find proportion of polygon that is rocky reef (areas in EPSG:6372 meters)
rocky_reef <- rocky_reef |>
  mutate(
    rocky_km2 = rocky_ha / 100, # Convert rocky_ha from hectares to km2
    polygon_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6, # Find area of polygons
    prop_rocky_reef = rocky_km2 / polygon_km2 # Find proportion of polygon that is rocky reef
  )
```


```{r}
# 100 m template nested under the fishing 1 km grid (same CRS, origin, extent)
# so aggregate(fact = 10) lands exactly on the fishing cells
template_100m <- disagg(rast(fishing_rasters[[1]]), fact = 10)
```

# Rocky reef rasterization:
```{r}
# Rasterize rocky reef polygon proportions
rocky_reef_prop_r <- rasterize(vect(rocky_reef), template_100m, field = "prop_rocky_reef", background = 0)

```

```{r}
# Check to see if the min and max are between 0-1
max(rocky_reef_prop_r)
```


```{r}
# Rasterize the vector seamounts data
seamounts_r  <- rasterize(vect(seamounts),  template_100m, field = 1, background = 0)
```


## Quick validation
```{r}
# Check if values are between 0-1
max(seamounts_r)
```

```{r}
# Both layers already rasterized onto template_100m — confirm alignment
compareGeom(rocky_reef_prop_r, template_100m, stopOnError = TRUE)
compareGeom(seamounts_r, template_100m, stopOnError = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Make raster where 0 = no hard‑bottom and 1+ = hard‑bottom present
hard_bottom_100m <- rocky_reef_prop_r +
                    seamounts_r
```

```{r}
# Check if values are between 0-1
max(hard_bottom_100m)
```

```{r}
# Cap values at 1 to make a proportion
hard_bottom_100m[hard_bottom_100m > 1] <- 1
```


```{r}
# Groups every 10×10 block of 100‑m cells into one 1‑km cell, and computes the mean of values inside that block
hard_bottom_fraction <- aggregate(hard_bottom_100m, fact = 10, fun = "mean")

# flips the fraction so more soft bottom = 1
soft_bottom_fraction <- 1 - hard_bottom_fraction
```

```{r}
# Check if values are between 0-1
max(soft_bottom_fraction)
```



```{r}
# Mask to the OHI marine region extent
marine_mask <- rasterize(
  vect(ohi_marine),
  soft_bottom_fraction,
  field = 1,
  background = NA
)

soft_bottom_fraction <- mask(soft_bottom_fraction, marine_mask)

```

## Destructive fishing data

Fishing rasters were loaded above (master grid in EPSG:6372). Soft-bottom habitat was rasterized onto that same nested grid after transforming all shapefiles to Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC.

Average head rope length: 0.030 km
Average vessel trawl speed: 3.7 km/h
```{r}
# Convert fishing hours to area km² of disturbance for each raster cell
# (already on fishing grid; no spatial transform)
disturbance_raster_km2 <- fishing_rasters * 3.7 * 0.030
compareGeom(disturbance_raster_km2, fishing_rasters[[1]], stopOnError = TRUE)
compareGeom(soft_bottom_fraction, fishing_rasters[[1]], stopOnError = TRUE)
```


## Take sum of pressures for each region and take the sum of soft bottom for each region 
## Then divide total pressures by total soft bottom in the region

disturbance_raster_km2 = the area covered by trawlers
```{r}
# now get pressure
prop_disturbed <- disturbance_raster_km2/soft_bottom_fraction
# Cap pressure at 1 - assumes that going over the same spot multiple times introduces minimal extra impact.
prop_disturbed[prop_disturbed > 1] <- 1
prop_disturbed[is.infinite(prop_disturbed)] <- 0

## save for rhodoliths
# Intermediate: soft-bottom fishing pressure (0–1) for rhodolith use
int_dir <- here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/int")
# One multi-layer GeoTIFF (layers = years 2007–2025)
names(prop_disturbed) <- paste0("prop_disturbed_", years)
writeRaster(
  prop_disturbed,
  filename = file.path(int_dir, "prop_disturbed_soft_bottom_1km.tif"),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

area_soft_bottom_disturbed = prop_disturbed * soft_bottom_fraction
```

Make plot of destructive fishing pressure.
```{r}
# Land first (gray), then soft-bottom raster, then marine borders
plot(vect(ohi_land), col = "gray85", border = "gray60", lwd = 0.5,
     main = "Fishing pressure", axes = FALSE, box=FALSE)
plot(
  prop_disturbed,
  add = TRUE,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "viridis"),
  range = c(0, 1),
  legend = FALSE,
  axes = FALSE, 
  box = FALSE
)
plot(vect(ohi_marine), add = TRUE, border = "gray70", lwd = 0.7, col = NA, box=FALSE, axes=FALSE)

```


soft_bottom_fraction = soft bottom area (fraction ≈ km² on 1 km cells)
```{r}
# Rasterize OHI region IDs onto the fishing grid (vectors already in EPSG:6372)
template <- rasterize(
  vect(ohi_marine),
  fishing_rasters[[1]],
  field = "id",
  background = NA
)
compareGeom(template, fishing_rasters[[1]], stopOnError = TRUE)

# Extract region_ids
region_ids <- as.vector(values(template))

# Number of cells in the fishing-aligned region raster
n_cells <- ncell(template)

# Number of years in the disturbance stack
n_years <- nlyr(area_soft_bottom_disturbed)

# Build a tibble where each row = one pixel × one year
df_regions <- tibble(
  region_id        = rep(region_ids, times = n_years), # Region ID for each pixel, repeated for every year
  year             = rep(years, each = n_cells), # Year column: each year repeated for all n_cells pixels
  disturbed_area   = as.vector(values(area_soft_bottom_disturbed)), # Disturbed soft-bottom area (km²) for each pixel × year
  soft_bottom_area = rep(as.vector(values(soft_bottom_fraction)), times = n_years)  # Soft-bottom area (km²) for each pixel — same every year
)

# Remove rows with missing region IDs or invalid numeric values
df_regions <- df_regions |>
  filter(!is.na(region_id), !is.nan(disturbed_area), !is.nan(soft_bottom_area))

df_regions
```

```{r}
# Calculate Pressure and SOF score for each region for each year
pressure_df <- df_regions |>
  group_by(region_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    disturbed_sum   = sum(disturbed_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    soft_bottom_sum = sum(soft_bottom_area, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pressure        = disturbed_sum / soft_bottom_sum,
    SOF_score       = 1 - Pressure,
    Pressure        = Pressure * 100,
    SOF_score       = SOF_score * 100,  
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pressure_df
# SOF score per region per year.
# Condition (SOF_score) is stored to 1 decimal. The 0–100 pressure is the complement of that rounded condition.
write_csv(
  pressure_df |>
    mutate(
      SOF_score = round(SOF_score, 1),
      Pressure = round(100 - SOF_score, 1)
    ),
  here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/SOF_outputs/sof_region_scores_per_year.csv"))

# pressure_df <- read_csv(here::here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/SOF_outputs/sof_region_scores_per_year.csv"))

```

## Trend Calculation

```{r}
# Trend Calculation: lm for most recent 5 years of data
year_end <- max(condition_df$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_start <- year_end - 4
calc_trends <- function(d) {
  ys <- min(d$year)
  ye <- max(d$year)
  cs <- d$condition[d$year == ys][1]
  fit_lin <- lm(condition ~ year, data = d)
  fit_log <- lm(log(condition) ~ year, data = d)
  slope_lin <- unname(coef(fit_lin)["year"])
  slope_log <- unname(coef(fit_log)["year"])
  tibble(
    year = ye,
    year_start = ys,
    year_end = ye,
    condition_start = round(cs, 1),
    trend_pct_linear = (slope_lin / cs) * 100,              # slope / start * 100
    trend_pct_cagr   = (exp(slope_log) - 1) * 100           # slope from log model
  )
}
trend_df <- condition_df |>
  filter(year >= year_start, year <= year_end) |>
  group_by(region_id) |>
  group_modify(~ calc_trends(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

trend_df

write_csv(trend_df, here::here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/SOF_outputs/sof_trend.csv"))
```

## Soft bottom by depth class

The files above are the combined habitat. This section does not replace them, and it does not change the disturbed-proportion raster saved for rhodoliths.

The same swept-area score is calculated twice. Soft bottom of 100 m or less uses `mask_depth_le_100m_1km.tif`. Soft bottom deeper than 100 m uses `mask_depth_gt_100m_1km.tif`. Those masks already partition the marine grid: a cell with any bathymetry sample of 100 m or less is shallow, and a coastal marine cell with no in-water sample is shallow as well. Every other marine cell is deep.

Within a class, the cell calculation is unchanged. Disturbance in km² is fishing hours times 3.7 km/h times a 0.030 km headrope. The cell ratio of disturbance to soft-bottom area is capped at 1. The regional pressure is the sum of that capped disturbed area divided by the sum of soft-bottom area. Condition is 100 times 1 minus that pressure. Trend is the 2021–2025 change in condition, linear and as a compound rate.

A cell's hours stay with that cell. Regions 1 and 5 have no cells deeper than 100 m, so they are left out of the deep files. Because the two classes do not overlap, adding their disturbed area and their soft-bottom area should recover the combined score above. Saved condition is rounded to 1 decimal. Saved pressure, on the 0–1 scale, is rounded to 2 decimals. The area columns stay unrounded.

```{r}
# Depth masks are 1 inside the class, 0 in other marine cells, empty outside.
shelf_mask <- rast(here(
  "_habitats", "HAB_soft_bottom", "int", "mask_depth_le_100m_1km.tif"
))
deep_mask <- rast(here(
  "_habitats", "HAB_soft_bottom", "int", "mask_depth_gt_100m_1km.tif"
))
compareGeom(shelf_mask, soft_bottom_fraction, stopOnError = TRUE)
compareGeom(deep_mask, soft_bottom_fraction, stopOnError = TRUE)
compareGeom(shelf_mask, template, stopOnError = TRUE)

# Same marine cells as the combined score: a region id and a soft-bottom value.
score_cells <- !is.na(values(template)[, 1]) & !is.na(values(soft_bottom_fraction)[, 1])
shelf_vals <- values(shelf_mask)[, 1]
deep_vals <- values(deep_mask)[, 1]
n_unassigned <- sum(score_cells & (is.na(shelf_vals) | (shelf_vals == 0 & deep_vals == 0)), na.rm = TRUE)
n_overlap <- sum(score_cells & shelf_vals == 1 & deep_vals == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Combined-score cells in neither mask:", n_unassigned, "\n")
cat("Combined-score cells in both masks:", n_overlap, "\n")
stopifnot(n_unassigned == 0, n_overlap == 0)
```

```{r}
# Regional score for one depth class.
# Rows are written only where that class has soft-bottom area.
score_depth_class <- function(mask) {
  soft_class <- soft_bottom_fraction * mask
  disturbance_class <- disturbance_raster_km2 * mask

  prop_class <- disturbance_class / soft_class
  prop_class[prop_class > 1] <- 1
  prop_class[is.infinite(prop_class)] <- 0
  disturbed_class <- prop_class * soft_class

  n_cells <- ncell(template)
  n_years <- nlyr(disturbed_class)
  class_df <- tibble(
    region_id = rep(as.integer(values(template)[, 1]), times = n_years),
    year = rep(years, each = n_cells),
    in_class = rep(values(mask)[, 1], times = n_years),
    disturbed_area = as.vector(values(disturbed_class)),
    soft_bottom_area = rep(as.vector(values(soft_class)), times = n_years)
  ) |>
    filter(in_class == 1, !is.na(region_id)) |>
    filter(!is.nan(disturbed_area), !is.nan(soft_bottom_area))

  class_df |>
    group_by(region_id, year) |>
    summarise(
      disturbed_sum = sum(disturbed_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      soft_bottom_sum = sum(soft_bottom_area, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    filter(soft_bottom_sum > 0) |>
    mutate(
      pressure = round(disturbed_sum / soft_bottom_sum, 2),
      condition = pmin(round((1 - disturbed_sum / soft_bottom_sum) * 100, 1), 100)
    )
}

# Same trend definition as the combined habitat.
# The log fit needs a positive condition in every year of the window.
calc_trends_depth <- function(d) {
  ys <- min(d$year)
  ye <- max(d$year)
  cs <- d$condition[d$year == ys][1]
  fit_lin <- lm(condition ~ year, data = d)
  slope_lin <- unname(coef(fit_lin)["year"])
  trend_log <- NA_real_
  if (all(d$condition > 0)) {
    fit_log <- lm(log(condition) ~ year, data = d)
    slope_log <- unname(coef(fit_log)["year"])
    trend_log <- (exp(slope_log) - 1) * 100
  }
  tibble(
    year = ye,
    year_start = ys,
    year_end = ye,
    condition_start = round(cs, 1),
    trend_pct_linear = (slope_lin / cs) * 100,
    trend_pct_cagr = trend_log
  )
}

write_depth_outputs <- function(scores, file_suffix) {
  out_dir <- here("_habitats", "HAB_soft_bottom", "SOF_outputs")
  write_csv(
    scores |>
      transmute(
        region_id,
        year,
        disturbed_sum,
        soft_bottom_sum,
        Pressure = round(100 - condition, 1),
        SOF_score = condition
      ),
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("sof_region_scores_per_year_", file_suffix, ".csv"))
  )
  write_csv(
    scores |> select(region_id, year, condition),
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("sof_status_", file_suffix, ".csv"))
  )
  write_csv(
    scores |> select(region_id, year, pressure),
    file.path(out_dir, paste0("sof_pressure_", file_suffix, ".csv"))
  )

  year_end <- max(scores$year)
  trend <- scores |>
    filter(year >= year_end - 4, year <= year_end) |>
    group_by(region_id) |>
    group_modify(~ calc_trends_depth(.x)) |>
    ungroup()
  write_csv(trend, file.path(out_dir, paste0("sof_trend_", file_suffix, ".csv")))
  trend
}

shelf_scores <- score_depth_class(shelf_mask)
deep_scores <- score_depth_class(deep_mask)
shelf_trend <- write_depth_outputs(shelf_scores, "le_100m")
deep_trend <- write_depth_outputs(deep_scores, "gt_100m")

cat(
  "Deep habitat has no cells for region(s):",
  paste(setdiff(1:9, unique(deep_scores$region_id)), collapse = ", "),
  "\n"
)
```

The two class totals should add back to the combined score. A difference here would mean a cell was dropped or counted twice.

```{r}
split_sums <- bind_rows(shelf_scores, deep_scores) |>
  group_by(region_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    disturbed_split = sum(disturbed_sum),
    soft_split = sum(soft_bottom_sum),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

depth_split_check <- pressure_df |>
  transmute(
    region_id = as.integer(region_id),
    year = as.integer(year),
    disturbed_original = disturbed_sum,
    soft_original = soft_bottom_sum,
    pressure_original = Pressure / 100
  ) |>
  left_join(split_sums, by = c("region_id", "year")) |>
  mutate(
    pressure_split = disturbed_split / soft_split,
    abs_soft_diff = abs(soft_split - soft_original),
    abs_disturbed_diff = abs(disturbed_split - disturbed_original),
    abs_pressure_diff = abs(pressure_split - pressure_original)
  )

cat("Max |soft-bottom difference|, km²:", max(depth_split_check$abs_soft_diff), "\n")
cat("Max |disturbed-area difference|, km²:", max(depth_split_check$abs_disturbed_diff), "\n")
cat("Max |pressure difference|:", max(depth_split_check$abs_pressure_diff), "\n")
stopifnot(max(depth_split_check$abs_soft_diff) < 1e-3)
stopifnot(max(depth_split_check$abs_pressure_diff) < 1e-5)
```

```{r}
# Soft-bottom area is the denominator of the pressure score. It does not change by year.
area_by_class <- full_join(
  shelf_scores |>
    filter(year == max(year)) |>
    select(region_id, shelf_soft_km2 = soft_bottom_sum),
  deep_scores |>
    filter(year == max(year)) |>
    select(region_id, deep_soft_km2 = soft_bottom_sum),
  by = "region_id"
) |>
  arrange(region_id)

area_by_class |>
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c("Region", "≤ 100 m soft bottom, km²", "> 100 m soft bottom, km²"),
    caption = "Soft-bottom area in each depth class. Empty cells are regions with no habitat in that class."
  ) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered"), full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r}
year_to_show_depth <- max(shelf_scores$year)
scores_2025 <- full_join(
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
depth_colors <- c(
  "100 m or shallower" = "#f4a261",
  "Deeper than 100 m" = "#1d3557"
)

condition_by_depth <- bind_rows(
  shelf_scores |> mutate(depth_class = "100 m or shallower"),
  deep_scores |> mutate(depth_class = "Deeper than 100 m")
) |>
  mutate(
    depth_class = factor(depth_class, levels = names(depth_colors)),
    region_id = factor(region_id, levels = 1:9)
  )

ggplot(condition_by_depth, aes(x = year, y = condition, color = depth_class)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ region_id, ncol = 3, labeller = labeller(region_id = function(x) paste("Region", x))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = depth_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "Soft-bottom condition by depth class",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
map_depth_status <- function(scores, title) {
  ohi_map <- ohi_regions |>
    left_join(
      scores |>
        filter(year == max(scores$year)) |>
        transmute(id = as.integer(region_id), condition),
      by = "id"
    )
  ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data = dplyr::filter(ohi_map, location == "land"), fill = "#f5e6c8", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_sf(data = dplyr::filter(ohi_map, location == "marine"), aes(fill = condition), color = "gray20", linewidth = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette = "RdYlGn",
      direction = 1,
      name = "Condition",
      limits = c(0, 100),
      breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
      na.value = "grey85"
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

map_depth_status(shelf_scores, "Soft bottom ≤ 100 m, condition in 2025")
map_depth_status(deep_scores, "Soft bottom > 100 m, condition in 2025")
```
